Speaks Vite's vite-hmr protocol with the fixture server's /hmr/vite?channel=… (the channel is this page's ?channel=), as Vite 8's client does: an update re-imports each updated module and logs [vite] hot updated: … (or [vite] Failed to reload …), full-reload reloads, and error shows an overlay without logging. hmrConnected is set once the socket greeted. Tests push messages with POST /hmr/send?channel=…; the button posts an update of cart.js, as if it was saved while a click ran.
